column4: Run paired compatibility preflight for all six immutable HTTPX, attrs, and pytest snapshots registered in runs/drift-confirmatory-v1/registration.json. Pin runtime and dependencies, preserve full logs and source hashes, leave tests and warnings intact, and record each pair's outcome. This is a behavioral gate only; do not compare or infer.

Using only the frozen confirmatory-v1 registration and objective-only label ledger, prepare and freeze sample-bound held-out inputs, prompt/arm schedule, model revision, six snapshot-specific adapter/corpus provenance, scorer revision, and exact runner registration. Do not run inference, smoke, or scoring. Record any input that cannot be prepared as an exact blocker.

Independently audit the exact six-snapshot behavioral receipts and all confirmatory-v1 generative input/adapter/scorer hashes, label scope, chronology, and no-inference claim. Publish PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED. A PASS is required before the blocked original final-gate audit may resume; do not run a comparison.
